Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<line>

<line> contains one line of a reference edition.
Attributes Global attributes only
Example 
<(La)page n="32">
 <(La)line n="1"><!-- text of edition La, p. 32, l. 1--> </(La)line>
 <(La)line n="2"><!-- text of edition La, p. 32, l. 2 --></(La)line>
 <(La)line n="3"><!-- text of edition La, p. 32, l. 3 --> </(La)line>
 <(La)line n="4"><!-- text of edition La, p. 32, l. 4 --> </(La)line>
 </(La)page>
Module Declared in file teipl2; Auxiliary tag set for concurrent markup of pages and lines
Data Description May contain character data only.
May contain
May occur within
Declaration 
<!ELEMENT line %om.RR;  (#PCDATA)> 
<!ATTLIST line  
      %a.global;>
See further 31.6 Concurrent Markup for Pages and Lines
